title: The Library Card
introduction: این داستان کمی طولانی‌تر است. به عبارت‌های درخواست مؤدبانه و افعال گذشته توجه کن.
paragraphs: On Wednesday afternoon, Daniel visited the public library because he wanted to find a book about space. He had never borrowed a book from this library before.
At the front desk, he asked the librarian how to get a library card. She explained that he needed an ID and a form with his address.
Daniel filled in the form and showed his ID. A few minutes later, the librarian gave him a new card. She also showed him where to find books about science.
Daniel chose a book about the planets. Before leaving, he asked when he had to return it. “You can keep it for two weeks,” the librarian replied.
Daniel thanked her and walked home. He was excited to start reading that evening.
